brief:
Benjamin Netanyahu won unexpectedly strong support from Israeli Jews in an election characterized as a historic turning point for the country, according to Al-Monitor. The results appear to secure his position despite ongoing political challenges and legal issues.

The election outcome defied predictions of a closer contest, with Netanyahu's coalition securing a decisive mandate from Jewish voters ahead of the government's next phase.

title: Netanyahu gains clear majority backing from Israeli Jews in election
